purpose: Apologize for an action or resulting situation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
て-form + すみません; past apology すみませんでした.
I am sorry I am late.
I am sorry to call so suddenly.
I am sorry I kept you waiting so long.
formation: て-form + すみません; past apology すみませんでした.
restrictions: A specific apology normally names what caused inconvenience.
mistake: For not doing something, なくてすみません is often needed.
